title: Nutritious Silky Croatian Noodles
description: A fatty and silky Croatian dish featuring flat rice noodles and tadka, made with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients. This meal prep dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the flat rice noodles according to package instructions.
Heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the mustard seeds and cumin seeds to the skillet and let them sizzle for 1 minute.
Add the turmeric, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Add the grated carrot to the skillet and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the chopped walnuts to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Drain the cooked noodles and add them to the skillet, stirring to combine with the tadka mixture.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
